saw_lines: Hand care buyers pick a scent once, then reorder it when the first bottle runs out.
So the sale is won in line one, where buyers decide if the scent fits. A slogan opener loses that reader.
Your 7 of 13 copy ads open on one line, still. grounded. serene. Name two or three new angles, like Vivid Bloom and Orange Grove, and run each against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Nov 2026
points: 7 of 13 copy ads open on the same “still. grounded. serene.” line, so a buyer who scrolls past one sees the same pitch. Name two or three new angles, like Vivid Bloom and Orange Grove, and run each against it.
One exact copy runs in 7 of 13 ads, so repeat viewers get the same words and stop reading. Keep it, but rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each ad so it reads as new.
None of your 25 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has little reason to trust the claim. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
9 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so the buyer has to search for the scent. Point each to the product page for the item it shows, so the click lands on what the buyer just saw.

ads_1: Scent led creative with fresh openers for Serene Wood, Vivid Bloom and Orange Grove
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, your only linked channel
